title: Project name
description: The name shown in the project list and written into the generated Mesh2HRTF project metadata. Changing it does not move or rename the project folder.

title: Left ear
description: The left pinna mesh used as input. The file is read during preprocessing; it can be omitted when only a right-ear project is needed.

title: Right ear
description: The right pinna mesh used as input. The file is read during preprocessing; it can be omitted when only a left-ear project is needed.

title: Save location
description: The project root. Pinna2HRTF stores Project Settings.yaml, the input meshes, Intermediates, Mesh2HRTF Projects, and finished HRTF files below this folder.

title: Use Mesh2PPM
description: Runs Mesh2PPM inference before preprocessing and uses the predicted meshes as the ear inputs. Disable this to preprocess the selected input meshes directly.

title: Model
description: Selects the bundled pretrained Mesh2PPM model and its matching camera-view configuration. Local 3 Views is the default model.

title: Evaluation grid
description: The directions at which Mesh2HRTF evaluates the simulated sound field. Default uses the bundled default evaluation grid.

title: Use custom head radius
description: Enables manual placement of the input pinnae at a specified lateral head radius before the dummy head is created. Leave disabled to preserve the input placement.

title: Head radius
description: The lateral distance in millimetres used to place the left and right pinnae before head construction. This value is used only when Use custom head radius is enabled.

title: Min frequency
description: The lower bound of the simulated frequency range in hertz.

title: Max frequency
description: The upper bound of the simulated frequency range in hertz.

title: Frequency steps
description: The number of frequency samples spanning the selected range. It must be at least 2; the default is 129 samples.

title: Microphone faces
description: The number of nearby mesh faces used to define the reciprocal microphone/source region around the estimated ear-canal entrance. The default is 6.

title: Min edge length
description: The smallest allowed mesh edge length in millimetres. Smaller elements preserve more detail near the high-resolution ear side; the default is 0.5 mm.

title: Max edge length
description: The largest allowed mesh edge length in millimetres. Elements can become this large farther from the high-resolution ear side; the default is 10 mm.

title: Max error
description: The maximum permitted geometric remeshing error in millimetres. The default is 0.5 mm. This value is passed to the hybrid mesh-grading algorithm.

title: Gamma
description: The grading factor used to estimate the active ear-canal entrance for mesh grading. The default is 0.2.

title: Gamma opposite
description: The grading factor used to estimate the contralateral ear-canal entrance while grading the active side. The default is 0.1.

title: Parallel instances
description: The maximum number of NumCalc frequency jobs that may run concurrently. More instances can shorten a run but use more CPU and memory; the default is 1.

title: CPU limit (%)
description: The CPU-load threshold used by the local scheduler before starting additional NumCalc work. The default is 90%.

title: Adaptive FMM expansion length
description: Lets NumCalc adapt the fast-multipole expansion length to the local cluster geometry. It is enabled by default and can improve stability and resource use for non-uniform meshes.

title: Normalize HRTFs
description: Enables the fixed broadband level adjustment applied to generated SOFA files during postprocessing. It changes overall gain, not the directional spectral shape.

title: Level offset
description: The broadband gain adjustment in decibels applied during postprocessing when Normalize HRTFs is enabled. The default is -30 dB.
